title: Page 68
transc:
G. D. Sheldon F Monroe  Washn May 9th 1864
Growl Rosetta May Pony to Pandora Biggs Vincent Annimal
we need wayworn power to tow barges & schooners 
with supplies & horses we have also about Plank
promise person publish to Pebble purple spit to send 
to waylay Knave among them a veteran whip of
Nuptial send weasel tow boats & also weaselers to
whimper these men up Bergen Do this immy Bender


JW Sampson Balto  Washn May 11th 1864
Jennie for Submit unity As soon as a Wharton of
Abner Militia wicks to you in Baptism you will send
the Platina Amos Simms Nuptial Pandora Porter to this place
to white to Shelby Augur for wherry to the Opal
of the Attica zodiac Notify Shelter Augur when it is
ready to move sig Irland


S. P. Kimber Care Gen Canby  Washn May 12th 1864 1230 PM 
Happy May Hoffman Topsy For Mastiff Tulip Dispatches just
received from Nutmeg dated Little Rock May Baker yacht
A large number of wagons & animals were Quivered
in his Vulture and his main want now is 
Weasel Tulip He thinks the Wachita Wafer is the
best line of future operations against the Violets in
Audit & Southern Asp Welch Lady raining hard here
